description: This file defines the 'Meeting' class in a Java-based financial or scheduling application. It manages meeting details such as date, associated calendar, and client attendance, including methods for creation, updating, and attendance management.

classes.name: Meeting
classes.description: Entity representing a scheduled meeting, including date, calendar association, and client attendance details.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Factory method to create a new Meeting instance, validating the meeting date.

methods.name: associateClientsAttendance
methods.description: Associates a collection of client attendance records to the meeting, ensuring it is not set in the future.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates meeting details, primarily the meeting date, with validation.

methods.name: updateAttendance
methods.description: Updates attendance records for clients within the meeting, handling new and existing records.

methods.name: entityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the associated calendar entity.

methods.name: isCenterEntity
methods.description: Checks if the associated calendar entity is a center.

methods.name: isGroupEntity
methods.description: Checks if the associated calendar entity is a group.

methods.name: getMeetingDateLocalDate
methods.description: Returns the meeting date as a LocalDate object.

methods.name: isMeetingDateBefore
methods.description: Checks if the meeting date is before a specified date.

methods.name: getClientsAttendance
methods.description: Retrieves the set of attendance records for clients.
